stem_md: 设 $z=xf(2x,y^2/x)$，$f$ 有连续二阶偏导数，求 $z_{xy}$。
analysis_md:
令 $u=2x,v=y^2/x$，则 $z=xf(u,v)$。

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)=x\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot0+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot\frac{2y}{x}\right)=2y\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}$

$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=2y\left[\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right)\right]=2y\left(\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial v^2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)$

$=2y\left[\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot2+\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial v^2}\cdot\left(-\frac{y^2}{x^2}\right)\right]=4y\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u\partial v}-\frac{2y^3}{x^2}\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial v^2}$
